typography.instructions: Replace Anton and IBM Plex with Oswald and Manrope. Use Oswald for English uppercase/bold headings to convey a structured, mechanical, premium feel. Use Noto Sans Devanagari for Hindi. Use Manrope for body text. Ensure tight tracking (-tracking-tight) on large Oswald headings.

colors.strategy: Gunmetal & Amber. A balanced mix of warm off-white (light sections) and deep slate (dark sections) for broad appeal, swapping out the previous pure dark theme. Accent color shifts from pure red to a more premium, mature Burnt Orange/Amber.
colors.css_variables_update: Update index.css to reflect the new balanced palette. Remove pure black backgrounds. Create utilities for alternating section background colors.

visual_enhancers.textures: Keep the grain overlay but reduce opacity to 3% for a subtle mechanical grit without dirtying the light theme.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use mechanical 1px solid borders (`border-gray-200` on light, `border-gray-700` on dark) to define sections. Avoid heavy drop shadows; prefer flat, structural UI.
visual_enhancers.border_radius: Keep it sharp or very minimal (2px - 4px). Use `rounded-none` or `rounded-sm` max to maintain the industrial garage aesthetic.
visual_enhancers.gradients: No rainbow gradients. Use subtle linear gradients ONLY for image overlays (e.g., black to transparent to ensure white text readability).

layouts_and_spacing.rhythm: Alternate between background_light and background_dark for different sections to create the 'balanced' 90% appeal look.
layouts_and_spacing.hero: Dark section with the cinematic black sports bike image, overlay with subtle gradient. Kinetic typography stays.
layouts_and_spacing.marquee: Amber or Dark background. High contrast.
layouts_and_spacing.about_section: Light section. Use structural bento-like grid to combine the mechanic image with the service manifesto.
layouts_and_spacing.testimonials: Light or slightly offset gray section. Clean, professional review cards.
layouts_and_spacing.contact: Dark section to blend with the dark-styled Google Map seamlessly.

motion.framer_motion: Keep existing section reveal animations (fade in, slight slide up). Add subtle scale on hover for brand cards and testimonials.

hero_background.description: Parked black sports bike in a premium setting. Use this as the cinematic hero background with a dark/transparent overlay to ensure text contrast.

mechanic_about.description: Professional mechanic working on a motorcycle. Use in the About/Manifesto section.

specific_instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT change the functional structure, data-testids, or remove the WhatsApp/Call floating buttons.
Update index.css variables to reflect the balanced Gunmetal & Amber theme. Ensure CSS class `.pulse-ring-green` remains for WhatsApp (#25d366).
Replace the pure dark theme with alternating light and dark sections to achieve the user's 'balanced' request.
Use Oswald for English headings, Noto Sans Devanagari for Hindi, and Manrope for body text.

In the hero section, replace the old hero image with the provided cinematic black sports bike image. Use a gradient overlay (e.g., from black to transparent) to ensure the kinetic typography is readable.
For the About section, use a light theme background (e.g., slate-50) and structure the content with crisp, 1px borders.
Maintain the dark theme map in the Contact section, so make the Contact section's background dark to blend smoothly.
Update the primary CTA color to the new accent (Orange/Amber).
Make sure the 'Rate us on Google' and all other existing interactive elements stay intact.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts. Maintain the Awwwards-style typography and spacing.
Use generous padding (py-24, py-32) to separate sections.
Ensure contrast is APCA/WCAG compliant across all text over backgrounds.
Add transition effects on hover for buttons, cards, and links.
